body: It looks like you have 1000 documents and a scroll size of 4000. This all looks correct. What is wrong?

It's the other way around. I have over 4,000 documents that match that query, so I set scroll_size to 4000 so I could update them all in one request. But only 1,000 get updated at a time. I have to run the `_update_by_query` four times to get all documents updated, which is not what I expected.
I've reproduced this locally. The `size` parameter is getting set to the scroll size accidentally.

rename.from: scroll_size seems to be ignored in _update_by_query

body: @rfraposa I've renamed this to the actual issue.
Note: this doesn't effect 5.6. I've not tracked down the patch that changed it but I'll put together a fix.

issue.title: Fix update_by_query's default size parameter

issue.body:
We were accidentally defaulting it to the scroll size.
Untwists some of the tricks that we play with parsing
so that the size is no longer scrambled.

Closes #26761
